# messq_auth_ls

See `messq help exit-codes` for the exit-code contract.

## messq auth ls

list token ids, roles and stream patterns — never hashes

### Synopsis

List every token in the auth-file with its id, role set and stream patterns.
The digest column is deliberately absent: someone holding only a stored
hash could replay requests offline against any endpoint that accepts the
presented form, so listings prove nothing beyond WHAT each id may do.
Editing grants means editing the file line; the daemon picks the change up
when the reload seam lands with issue #17.

```
messq auth ls [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  messq auth ls --auth-file /etc/messq/tokens
  messq auth ls --output json | jq '.tokens[].id'
```

### Options

```
      --auth-file string   token file to inspect (or MESSQ_AUTH_FILE)
```
